name: International Literature Festival Berlin: Wandering Readings
venue: Documentation Centre for Displacement, Expulsion and Reconciliation
description: Part of the 25th International Literature Festival Berlin, this event features wandering readings where authors present texts and poems at four different locations within the Documentation Centre. The program explores themes of exile, displacement, and forced migration with poets and authors including Volha Hapeyeva, Ahmed Awny, Mazda Mehrgan, Hekma Yagoub, Ali Alzaeem, Mariia Kaziun, and Yasser Niksada. Between intervals, audience members move freely between spaces and presentations. The event includes the Exile Poetry Dispenser, featuring 20 authors giving voice to experiences of uprooting and loss of belonging.
